subject: Request: Same-day demo tonight (SGT) — FinVault integration

From: Claire Huang <claire@finvault.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 22:03:00 +08:00
Subject: Request: Same-day demo tonight (SGT) for FinVault integration

Hi Jordan —

Apologies for the late note. We just finished an internal architecture sync and our engineering and security leads are available tonight for a short 30–40 minute walkthrough of the Redwood integration. Would you be able to run a demo tonight at 22:30 SGT (UTC+8)?

Quick context: we accelerated the pilot and need to validate end-to-end latency and the model fallback behavior before Monday. If possible we’d like someone who can demonstrate the Dedicated and Hosted routing behavior and answer a few security questions around logging and data retention.

If you can’t make 22:30 SGT, please propose the next available slot within the 22:00–00:30 SGT window — we can be flexible but would prefer tonight. I attached a short priorities doc.

Thanks —
Claire Huang
Director of Platform Engineering, FinVault
claire@finvault.com
Attachments: FinVault-integration-priorities.pdf (PDF, 470KB)

Thanks for the context and the doc — appreciate the short notice. I can run through the Hosted vs Dedicated routing at a high level, but I want an engineer on the call to answer the live latency and logging questions. Looping in Laura (APAC coverage) to confirm who can join from infra/security.

Proposed: 22:30 SGT tonight (that’s 06:30 PDT / 15:30 BST). If we need stronger ops detail I’ll add Vivek to the bridge. Please confirm and I’ll send the invite + link.

Laura / Vivek —

Customer (FinVault) just asked for a same-day demo at 22:30 SGT tonight. Claire Huang and Rajiv Menon are on the thread and want ops/security details (latency stats, logging/retention, model fallback). I can handle the product tour but I need an engineer who can answer:
- expected p99 token latency on Dedicated vs Hosted for 4k seq (on A100-equivalent)
- what’s in the audit log for inference requests (token-level vs request-level)
- fallback policy behavior when Dedicated capacity is constrained

They attached a short priorities doc (see below). Can one of you cover the 22:30 SGT slot? If yes I’ll send the calendar invite and put the required prep notes in the event. This is time-sensitive — they need validation before Monday.
